title: SuSi-RAG: A Hybrid Graph RAG for Equipment Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.30588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the manufacturing domain, equipment maintenance tasks depend on expert knowledge. Their documentation is often stored in heterogeneous formats and sources. The enhancement of LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is promising for bridging the scattered knowledge, but traditional vector-based RAG shows weaknesses with two characteristics which are common in real maintenance queries: complex causal chains and cross-domain synthesis. To address this, we propose SuSi-RAG, a hybrid Graph RAG solution, that matches a user query and each maintenance record using subgraph similarity. This work shows an in-use system: SuSi-RAG has run on an active Bosch production line for more than eight months, handling 10,664 question-answer interactions and demonstrates upper bound answer accuracy of 96.25% (confirmed error rate 3.75%). In a proof-of-concept, SuSi-RAG improves top-1 retrieval accuracy from 61.5% to 96.2% and expert-rated answer

translated_title: SuSi-RAG：一种面向设备维护的混合图检索增强生成方案
translated_abstract: 在制造领域，设备维护任务依赖于专家知识，而其文档通常以异构的格式和来源存储。利用检索增强生成（RAG）来增强大语言模型（LLM）有望弥合这些分散的知识，但传统的基于向量的RAG在面对真实维护查询中常见的两个特征——复杂因果链和跨领域综合——时表现出明显弱点。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SuSi-RAG，一种混合图RAG解决方案，通过子图相似度将用户查询与每条维护记录进行匹配。本工作展示了一个已实际投入使用的系统：SuSi-RAG已在博世（Bosch）一条活跃的生产线上运行超过八个月，处理了10,664次问答交互，答案准确率上限达到96.25%（确认错误率为3.75%）。在概念验证中，SuSi-RAG将top-1检索准确率从61.5%提升至96.2%，专家评分的答案质量也得到显著改善。
tldr: SuSi-RAG是一种通过子图相似度匹配用户查询与维护记录的混合图检索增强生成方案，已在博世生产线实际运行超过八个月，将top-1检索准确率从61.5%提升至96.2%，有效解决了传统向量RAG在复杂因果链和跨领域综合查询上的不足。
en_tdlr: SuSi-RAG is a hybrid Graph RAG solution that matches user queries with maintenance records via subgraph similarity, which has run on an active Bosch production line for over eight months and improved top-1 retrieval accuracy from 61.5% to 96.2%, addressing the weaknesses of traditional vector-based RAG in complex causal chains and cross-domain synthesis queries.
